title: Passive voice in all tenses & modals · 各时态与情态动词的被动语态
pattern: Subject + be (+ being / been / will be / can be) + Past participle
summary: 被动语态可以与各种时态和情态动词组合：is being done、has been done、will be done、can be done。
explanation: 被动语态的核心始终是 **be + V3**，变化的只是 be 的形式：一般现在时 is / are，一般过去时 was / were，进行时 is / are / was / were **being** + V3，完成时 has / have / had **been** + V3，将来时 will **be** + V3，情态动词后面则是 can / must / should **be** + V3。
进行时被动常用于描述“正在发生”的事：The bridge **is being repaired** this week.（这座桥本周正在维修）。完成时被动强调“已经完成”的结果：Many trees **have been cut down** in the park.（公园里不少树已经被砍掉了）。
将来时被动的结构是 will be + V3：The new library **will be opened** next spring. 情态动词的被动同理：This question **can be answered** in two minutes.（这道题两分钟内可以作答）。
否定句要把 not 放在 be 或情态动词之后，疑问句则把助动词或情态动词提到主语前：The windows **must not be opened** during the test. / **Will** the results **be announced** today? / **Has** the package **been sent**?
注意 be 的形式：进行时用 being，完成时用 been，两者不能混用；而 will、can、must 之后永远是 be 的原形。翻译时先确定动作的承受者，再选择合适的时态和情态动词。
mistakes: ✗ The bridge is being build now. → ✓ The bridge is being built now. 过去分词 built 不能写成原形 build。
✗ The homework has been finish. → ✓ The homework has been finished. been 之后必须接过去分词，而不是动词原形。
✗ The results will be announce tomorrow. → ✓ The results will be announced tomorrow. 情态动词后的 be 之后同样要接过去分词。
✗ The car is being repairing. → ✓ The car is being repaired. being 之后接的是过去分词，不能用 -ing 形式。

examples.text: The bridge is being repaired this week.
examples.note: 现在进行时的被动：is being + V3。

examples.text: Many trees have been cut down in the park.
examples.translation: 公园里有很多树已经被砍掉了。
examples.note: 现在完成时的被动：have been + V3。

examples.text: The new library will be opened next spring.
examples.translation: 新图书馆明年春天将会开放。

examples.text: This question can be answered in two minutes.
examples.translation: 这道题两分钟内就可以作答。
examples.note: 情态动词的被动：can be + V3。

examples.text: Will the results be announced today?
examples.note: 疑问句：把 will 提到主语之前。

examples.text: The windows must not be opened during the test.
examples.translation: 考试期间不准打开窗户。

exercises.sentence: The letters ___ by the secretary right now.
exercises.translation: 秘书现在正在打这些信件。
exercises.explanation: right now 表示正在进行，应使用 are being typed。
next Friday 是将来时间，应使用 will be announced。

exercises.source: 这些书已经被翻译成了十种语言。
options: These books have been translated into ten languages.
These books have translated into ten languages.
These books are translated into ten languages.
These books were been translated into ten languages.
exercises.explanation: “已经被翻译”是完成时被动语态：have been translated。

options: The meal is being cooked now.
The meal has been cooked already.
The meal can cooked by him.
exercises.explanation: 情态动词后要用 be + 过去分词，应改为 The meal can be cooked by him。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 这个问题可以很容易地解决。
exercises.explanation: 情态动词 can 之后接 be + 过去分词 solved。
将来时被动疑问句：Will + 主语 + be + 过去分词 delivered。

exercises.source: 这些照片已经被删除了。
exercises.explanation: “已经被删除”是完成时被动：have been deleted。

exercises.sentence: The new road ___ at the moment.
exercises.explanation: at the moment 表示正在进行，应使用 is being built。

options: The documents will be signed tomorrow.
The documents will be sign tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: will be 之后要接过去分词 signed，应改为 The documents will be signed tomorrow。
